name: MoYu Super AoLong 3x3 (Magnetic, MagLev, 20-Magnet Ball-Core)
description: The MoYu Super AoLong 3x3 (Magnetic, MagLev, 20-Magnet Ball-Core) is a flagship speed cube designed for fast, controllable turning with deep, repeatable tuning. Piece magnets give precise layer “clicks,” MagLev removes spring friction for a quicker glide, and a 20-magnet ball-core adds corner-to-core attraction for exceptional stability—all in a compact 55.
features: Faster, more accurate turning: Magnetic pieces and 20-magnet ball-core improve corner alignment and control.
Low-friction MagLev feel: No springs, less maintenance, and a smoother, faster glide.
Compact, comfortable form factor: 55.5 mm size and ~70 g weight reduce fatigue and over-turns.
Stability you can trust: Upgraded positioning 3.0 and repulsion force snap layers back into alignment.
One-button triple adjustment: 8 magnet strengths, 8 tensions, 8 repulsion levels.
Dial in your feel: 64 tension/compression combos and 512 total tuning combinations —from light and fast to firm and controlled.
